title: StorageError::Database(String) erases sqlx error type information
description: StorageError::Database(String) in error.rs stringifies sqlx::Error on every DB failure. This throws away the error category (connection failure, constraint violation, timeout, etc.) making callers unable to distinguish recoverable from fatal storage errors. Replace with StorageError::Database(sqlx::Error) or at minimum StorageError::Database { message: String, retryable: bool }. The stringly-typed variant also makes automated error classification for metrics impossible.
